big: A client holds a thematic fund and a diversified fund, thinking she has spread her money. But both hold many of the same large companies. She is doubling up, not diversifying. A category is a promise about what a fund will hold.

lines: Why did SEBI change the category rules?

Because some thematic funds held many of the same large companies as diversified funds. The 2026 rules cap overlap at 50%, so sector and theme funds are genuinely different. That makes them better satellites, and more volatile, because they are more concentrated.

alt: Two bars showing overlap before and after a 50% cap
caps: Before: heavy overlap with diversified funds.
More distinct, but more concentrated and volatile.
